description: This file defines the CodecProvider class which manages serializers, codecs, copiers, and related objects for the Orleans serialization framework. It handles registration, retrieval, and creation of various serialization components, including support for surrogate codecs and dynamic type handling.

classes.name: CodecProvider
classes.description: Provides access to serializers, codecs, copiers, and activators for Orleans serialization, supporting dynamic registration and creation based on type metadata.

methods.name: TryGetCodec
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a typed codec for the specified type, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: GetCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a codec for the specified type, throwing if not found.

methods.name: TryGetCodec
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an untyped codec for the specified type.

methods.name: GetCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a typed codec for the specified type, throwing if not found.

methods.name: GetActivator
methods.description: Retrieves an activator for the specified type.

methods.name: TryCreateBaseCodec
methods.description: Creates a base codec for the specified type, considering surrogate codecs.

methods.name: GetBaseCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a base codec for the specified type, throwing if not found.

methods.name: GetValueSerializer
methods.description: Retrieves a value serializer for the specified value type.

methods.name: GetBaseCopier
methods.description: Retrieves a base copier for the specified type.

methods.name: GetDeepCopier
methods.description: Retrieves a deep copier for the specified type.

methods.name: TryGetDeepCopier
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a deep copier for the specified type.

methods.name: GetDeepCopier
methods.description: Retrieves a deep copier for the specified type, throwing if not found.
